verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for authentication products, since comparable auth vendors publish developer APIs. However, the evidence pack documents only end-user app features: sign-in, OTP codes, backup, passkeys and Verified ID. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, and nothing shows an API reference or runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
